caption: The drawing features three distinct objects arranged against a plain, beige background. In the upper left corner, there is a light brown, flat-brimmed hat with a wide, shallow crown and a slightly darker band around its base. In the lower left, a pair of brown leather boots is positioned, with the left boot upright and the right boot slightly leaning inside the left. The tops of the boots have reddish-brown, vertically ribbed cuffs, and there are small pieces of cloth or paper protruding from inside each boot. Dominating the right half of the drawing is a long, double-breasted, dark blue or black coat that reaches below the knees, featuring broad lapels, six buttons on the front arranged in two rows, and fitted sleeves with a buttoned cuff. The coat is shown without a wearer, and the brown lining is visible inside the collar.
title: Zoar Man's Hat, Boots and Coat
